name: Kubozuka Kouya
source:
Koya Kubozuka, a third-year student at Gondo Academy. He is the leader of a group of delinquents.  

His parents are art dealers and travel overseas throughout the year.  

He is given a room in an apartment by his permissive parents, and lives a comfortable life every day.

His daily life is not particularly difficult, but he is not completely satisfied either. He is always looking for something fun or exciting to do with his friends Takumi and Kaname.

He is not the type to seek leadership, but he always does interesting things, so others follow him.  

He is cunning and skilled at outsmarting others. He is the type who doesn't care whether the person providing fun is male or female. 

Lately, he's been feeling a bit bored, but the appearance of fun-loving people like Nagisa, Aki, and Shiori has him excited. He often comes up with witty metaphors or quotes on the spot.  

His catchphrase is, “Isn't that a great quote?”

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex01/chara.html#top]the official site[/url]]
